result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The scoping-related tests in `codeanalyzer` pass. I didn't add new tests, so the new matches (a `.htm` page, `MyAssembly.xml`, `app.js`, `build-gradle.js`) are not covered by a test.

- **Generated HTML (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the extension group was `(html|html|xhtml)`, with `html` written twice. It is now `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match and `.html` and `.xhtml` still do.
- **.NET assembly XML (`<doc>` line):** the path pattern `.*/[.]xml` is now `.*[.]xml`, so it matches `MyAssembly.xml` and not just a file named `.xml`.
- **`// Generated by …` JavaScript:** `.*/[.]js` is now `.*[.]js`, so it matches `app.js` and not just a file named `.js`.
- **Gradle JavaScript scripts:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so it matches `build-gradle.js`. The `.gradle` rule is unchanged, so `build.gradle` still matches.

The content patterns are unchanged, so hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of those scopes.
